note: Compiled 27 Nov 2026 from github.com/trending (fetched live) and community signals from Hacker News via last30days (Reddit, GitHub and Polymarket data were not available). Web search surfaced no verifiable same-day launches, so news is signal-driven; videos are carried over from the previous feed because no new YouTube ids could be verified.

news.title: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you
news.summary: An essay arguing agents should owe duties to their users. Hacker News: 1032 points, 414 comments; many commenters find the argument flimsy.

news.title: Oops I Parsed It Again: Tool-Call Smuggling Against LLM Agents
news.summary: Paper on attacks that smuggle tool calls past agent parsers. Only 3 points on Hacker News, so early, but relevant to anyone writing tool-calling loops.

news.title: A training engine for your local model, using your idle compute
news.summary: Songe (sous-labs) trains a local model from agent usage on idle compute. Hacker News: 238 points, 75 comments; the authors are replying to questions.

news.title: End-to-End 4-Bit Training (Thinking Machines)
news.summary: Engineering post on training in 4-bit precision end to end. 24 points on Hacker News.

news.title: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG (Apple)
news.summary: Apple ML research on learned retrieval. Hacker News: 243 points, 40 comments; some commenters doubt embeddings beat grep for code.

news.title: Cerebras launches disaggregated inference
news.summary: Cerebras splits inference stages across hardware, a serving-architecture idea relevant to prefill/decode design. Hacker News: 109 points, 27 comments.

news.title: Announcing the XLA Serving Engine
news.summary: Google launches a serving engine for XLA-based inference. Only 3 points on Hacker News so far.

news.title: Vibecoding an inference chip
news.summary: A blog post on designing an inference chip with AI-assisted coding. Hacker News: 180 points, 80 comments.

news.title: Apple has a new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
news.summary: Reported: Apple's Harbor app, in private preview, aims to simplify running local models. Hacker News: 580 points.

news.title: Pete Warden on local AI, open models and hardware
news.summary: Interview on local AI and the future of hardware. Hacker News: 274 points; commenters share home multi-GPU setups.
